item.title: Lowering your risk for heart disease
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- February is Heart Health month, and Indiana is thirteenth in the country with the most deaths from heart disease, according to the Indiana Women's Heart Alliance. Whether that's due to a heart attack, arrythmia, or other factors, it's a serious problem in the Hoosier State.

item.title: Senator Young discusses immigration enforcement tactics, DHS funding deal
item.description: WASHINGTON, DC -- Senator Young discusses deal to fund DHS, immigration enforcement tactics.

item.title: MeTV set to broadcast The Wizard of Oz for the first time in 30 years
item.description: CHICAGO, Ill. -- MeTV has secured the broadcast rights to air MGM's classic The Wizard of Oz in October.

item.title: South Bend Regional Chamber honors local leaders at Salute to Business
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Century Center in South Bend held the Salute to Business event organized by the South Bend Regional Chamber on Thursday.

item.title: Local woman's granddaughter fights to honor her legacy with street sign topper
item.description: BENTON TOWNSHIP, Mich. — A local woman's granddaughter is fighting to honor her grandmother's legacy while she's still here to receive her flowers.

item.title: Community leaders partner to address student attendance in South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Team Excel and Gentlemen and Scholars will be hosting a special Tackle Attendance session, featuring football standout Leonard Moore, aimed at reducing absenteeism in South Bend Community Schools by inspiring students and strengthening community support for academic engagement and personal growth.

item.title: Fighting Irish dominate Virginia Tech 80-70
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Fighting Irish scored in double figures on Thursday evening with an 80-70 victory over Virginia Tech at Purcell Pavilion.

item.title: Tiara Jackson appointed Elkhart County Auditor
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- On Thursday, Feb. 5., Tiara Jackson was named the new Elkhart County Auditor.

item.title: Heavy winter conditions stretch into February keeping road crews busy
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. — What started as an early and demanding winter is now stretching into February, keeping shovels, plows and snowblowers working overtime across St. Joseph County.

item.title: Expert fears dangers of extreme cost-cutting actions amid rising NIPSCO bills
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Pat McKelvey has spent his life working in the Michiana community and lately he’s seen a cry for help among Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) NIPSCO customers. He said he has first-hand seen many people use potentially deadly cost-cutting tactics to offset their rising bills.
